master.title: All payments (master switch)
master.description: Controls coin, diamond and Premium purchases on all platforms. When switched off, purchase buttons are hidden and payment pages are closed.
master.note: New orders are blocked; an open app re-checks the state every 30 seconds. Payments already in progress, receipt verification and free rewards keep working.

ios.title: App Store shop (iOS only)
ios.aria: Enable the iOS App Store shop
ios.description: When switched off, the money shop is completely hidden on iOS. Payme/Click sales on Android keep running — so an App Store problem (StoreKit outage, product not configured) never stops Android.
ios.note: iOS never falls back to Payme/Click: App Store Review 3.1.1 only allows selling digital currency through Apple IAP.
ios.masterOff: The master switch is off — iOS is closed anyway.
